layout: Single step screen. Light bg (#F8FAFC). Clean, professional feel. IDENTICAL LAYOUT to other steps — only content area changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Back arrow (top-left, active navy #003F8C). No skip link.
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered: 4 dot circles. Steps 1-2: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 3: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled. Step 4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
layout_structure.illustration: Large document/file icon centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'Documents' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Upload dokumen untuk verifikasi' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. DISABLED until mandatory docs uploaded.
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between sections. 16px horizontal padding mobile, 32px desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, navy #003F8C, active) left. No skip link.
PROGRESS: 4 horizontal dots. Dots 1-2: green (#22C55E) filled. Dot 3: orange (#FF8A34) filled. Dot 4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
SUBTITLE: 'Upload dokumen untuk verifikasi' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.
UPLOAD 1 — KTP (MANDATORY): Card with red asterisk. Icon: ID card. Button 'Upload KTP'. After upload: shows file name + size + green checkmark + 'Hapus' link. Max 5MB, PDF/JPG/PNG.
UPLOAD 2 — NPWP (MANDATORY): Card with red asterisk. Icon: tax document. Button 'Upload NPWP'. After upload: file name + size + green checkmark.
UPLOAD 3 — CERTIFICATES (OPTIONAL): Card with 'Opsional — wajib untuk tier Pro'. Icon: certificate. Button 'Upload Sertifikat'. Multiple files allowed (max 3). After upload: list of files with sizes.
UPLOAD 4 — EXPERIENCE PHOTOS (OPTIONAL): Card. Icon: photo. Button 'Upload Foto Pengalaman'. Max 5 photos. Grid preview thumbnails (80x80px) with remove '×'.

TEXT AREA — CLIENT TESTIMONIALS (OPTIONAL): Label 'Referensi Client Sebelumnya (Opsional)'. Textarea, 4 lines min. Placeholder: 'Nama + nomor HP client sebelumnya untuk verifikasi (pisahkan dengan koma)'
CTA: 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. Disabled until KTP & NPWP uploaded.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to other steps. KTP & NPWP mandatory. Upload shows file name, size, checkmark. Optional fields don't block CTA. File type/size validation inline.
